title: Supernatural: Dean Winchester #1
desc: DEAN WINCHESTER, IN HIS OWN SERIES FOR THE FIRST TIME! It’s an all-new adventure by Eisner-Award winning writer CHUCK BROWN (Bitter Root) and star artist RAPHA LOBOSCO (Mumm-Ra The Ever-Living)! He’s hurt. He’s alone. It’s Mardi Gras. The streets of New Orleans are crawling with creepiness, and the elder Winchester brother is determined to close a case his dad never could. To do so, he might have to murder a god. This issue features a cover by Stephen Byrne that connects with a cover on SUPERNATURAL: SAM WINCHESTER #1!
